interface_dependencies.browser: Uses existing global Module.canvas with #canvas fallback; owns Canvas 2D. No extra exports or web API required. Page Start calls main and focuses canvas, pointerdown refocuses. Existing page documents arrow move/turn, Ctrl fire, Space use, Shift run, Enter/Escape menus; header also documents Alt strafe, Tab map and digits weapons.
interface_dependencies.runtime: Runtime owns main, clock, sleep and removal of original stubs. Asyncify/event yielding required to deliver input; no timing callbacks here.
interface_dependencies.queue: At most 1024 pending events; overflow resynchronizes engine-delivered keys to physical holds, preserving releases rather than silently dropping them. Extremely excessive input may lose transient taps but cannot leave a permanently held key.
